title: Quietly Energizing Middle Eastern Lamb Shakshuka
description: A Mediterranean-inspired shakshuka dish featuring lamb, infused with the subtle flavor of shio-koji cure, served in an iron teppan, perfect for a quietly energizing meal. This dish combines the richness of lamb with the brightness of Middle Eastern spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the iron teppan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the shio-koji, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes and stir to combine.
Create 4 wells in the mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the teppan and cook until the eggs are set, about 10 minutes.
Serve the shakshuka hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
